summary_en: 3,500,000 shares (3.8% of S/O), ¥15.0B limit, open market purchase, 1 Oct 2026–31 Mar 2027. All acquired shares to be cancelled 31 Mar 2027. Rationale: capital efficiency, shareholder return, mitigation of demand impact from concurrent secondary offering.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 24 August 2026, the board of 日本空港ビルデング (Nippon Airport Building Co., Ltd., TSE Prime 9706) authorized a treasury stock acquisition program under Article 156(1) of the Companies Act (as applied by re-reading under Article 165(3)). The company will acquire up to 3,500,000 shares, representing 3.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury (denominator: 93,135,705 shares as of 30 June 2026), for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥15.0 billion. Acquisition will occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 1 October 2026 and 31 March 2027. All shares acquired under this program are to be cancelled effective 31 March 2027. The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns, and to mitigate supply-side pressure on the stock arising from a concurrent secondary offering of new shares announced the same day. The company has delegated final implementation authority to the President.
